fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The human-readable name of the security settings, unique within the location.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location these settings are located in.

fields.label: Purge Data Types
fields.help: List of types of data to remove when retention settings triggers purge.

fields.label: Redaction Scope
fields.help: Defines what types of data to redact.

fields.label: Retention Strategy
fields.help: Defines how long we retain persisted data that contains sensitive info.

fields.label: Retention Window Days
fields.help: Retains the data for the specified number of days.

fields.label: Audio Export Settings
Audio Format
fields.help: File format for exported audio file.

fields.label: Enable Audio Redaction
fields.help: Enable audio redaction if it is true.

fields.label: Gcs Bucket
fields.help: Cloud Storage bucket to export audio record to.
Controls audio export settings for post-conversation analytics when ingesting audio to conversations.

fields.label: Insights Export Settings
Enable Insights Export
fields.help: If enabled, we will automatically exports conversations to Insights and Insights runs its analyzers.
Controls conversation exporting settings to Insights after conversation is completed.
